notes: kb/Work PB5162 (landed). §1989:A.2.31.3 AR1: "Argument-1 must be one character in length and must be class alphabetic or alphanumeric." and the 1985 alphanumeric class holds the edited categories (§1985:IV.4.3.3). The Verified ORD row's CharacterCategory predicate now starts at 2002 (ArgPredicate.Since, asked through AppliesAt by CheckArgumentClasses), so at --std 85 a one-character numeric edited item is admitted: ORD of PIC Z holding 7 is 56, of PIC * holding the check-protect of 0 is 43 (pb5162_ord_numeric_edited_85). The ExactWidth(1) predicate refuses a two-character literal, item, group and reference modification (witness 1989-AR-A_2_31_3-1); Violation refuses a numeric item and literal.

next.reason: 1985: "must be class alphabetic or alphanumeric"; 2023: "shall be of category alphabetic, alphanumeric, or national". 2023 adds national arguments, which 1985 refused. It also says category, not class, which may exclude edited items that belong to class alphanumeric.
